title: About
text:
Vagish Hemmige
I work at the intersection of infectious diseases and transplantation, with a focus on HIV care & prevention, HIV-to-HIV thoracic transplantation, and building open, reproducible R workflows for large healthcare datasets.

title: About
text:
What I’m working on

Transplant & HIV: advancing pathways for HIV-positive donor thoracic transplants and sharing practical “how-to” resources for new programs.
Reproducible analytics in R: extensive experience using R to analyze clinical data.
Education: clinical reasoning, and bringing data skills to clinicians with approachable examples.

I have mentored trainees in case reports, clinical research, and big data/research methods.

While a remote trainee would need to obtain their own copy of the data, Github would enable collaboration on the analysis code.

text:
I have mentored trainees in case reports, clinical case series, and big data/research methods.
I am open to mentoring trainees and faculty at other institutions who are interested in working with big data sets such as the USRDS or the SRTR and performing their own analyses in R. While a remote trainee would need to obtain their own copy of the data, we can collaborate via GitHub on the analysis.
See projects for active R projects. Message me via GitHub if you are interested in collaborating remotely.

title: Research Projects
text:
We are working on a number of research projects related to the use of the R programming language with massive data sets in transplantation.
I also have collaborations with other centers to implement HIV D+/R+ thoracic transplantation programs. See HOPE Thoracic respository for further details.

title: Research Projects
text:
Cost-Effectiveness & Health Economics

Cryptococcus Cost Analysis ACTIVE
This project seeks to use the United States Renal Data System to study the additional cost attributable to an episode of cryptococcus after kidney transplantation. Longitudinal matching between patients with cryptococcus and similar controls without is used to calculate the attributable cost.
Methods: claims data, cost modeling, health economics
Project Site | GitHub


Cryptococcus Donor Screening CEA ACTIVE
Decision-analytic cost-effectiveness modeling of donor cryptococcal screening strategies in solid organ transplantation.
Methods: CEA, decision analysis, Monte Carlo simulation
Project Site | GitHub

title: Research Projects
text:
Research Infrastructure & Methods

Ellmer PubMed ATC 2026 Abstract Pipeline ACTIVE
Automated literature extraction and structured summarization from 100 PDFS using LLMs, with the results extracted directly into R. The pipeline uses the ellmer package to facilitate the analysis.
Methods: automation, LLM, structured extraction
Project Site | GitHub
